# Zone-Resolved Metabolic-Spread Diagnostic Summary

This diagnostic recomputes TSV probabilities for each zone and each metabolic profile, then reports both mean-zone and max-zone tail-risk aggregation.

- Predictor: `ordinal`
- BSA conversion mode: `paper_convention`
- Occupied timesteps: 2,405,376
- Zones per timestep: 15
- Zone-profile probability evaluations: 216,483,840
- Tail threshold: `p_tail >= 0.20`

## Headline Results

- Mean-zone `p_tail` spread, mean: 0.074; p95: 0.209
- Max-zone `p_tail` spread, mean: 0.137; p95: 0.327
- Mean-zone threshold flips: 19.0%
- Max-zone threshold flips: 38.7%
- `S-real` mean-zone hidden tail: 18.8%
- `S-real` any-zone hidden tail: 36.5%
- Warm/cold mean-tail direction flips: 17.1%
